verdict.rationale: AI-feature controls are a fair question for a terminal emulator, since some terminals ship built-in AI assistants. However, the WezTerm evidence never mentions any AI features, AI opt-out controls, disclosure of what session data leaves the machine, or login requirements. The pack covers only terminal, multiplexing, SSH, CLI and config capabilities, so there is no documented support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use or fully disable AI features with clear control over what session data leaves my machine, without a forced login
